primitives.name: Active Coverage vs Seeded Universe Ratio
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.assumptions: Coverage is normalized to [0,1]; legal usability implies contractual compliance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C_a < C_s indicates operational gap in data legality or access.

primitives.name: Source Trust Kernel with Conflict Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Coverage, source trust, conflict, freshness, proof, comps, archetypes, alerts, versioning, competitive, and king-standard foundations.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_i': 'trust score of source i (0 to 1)', 'F_{ij}': 'conflict factor between sources i and j (dimensionless)', 'P_i': 'proof strength of source i (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Trust scores are derived from legal and historical consistency; conflict is symmetric.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F_{ij} > threshold implies trust degradation in both sources.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes T_i * (1 - F_{ij}) as trust kernel; GSE applies it to resolve data state ambiguity in real-time.
layer2.telemetry: Average trust-adjusted conflict index across all source pairs.

primitives.name: Ten-Second Comprehension Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_x': 'UX comprehension score (0 to 1)', 'T_c': 'time to convey core data context (seconds)', 'M_d': 'missing data indicators (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Comprehension is a function of visual clarity and data density; U_x = f(T_c, M_d).
primitives.breakdown_regime: T_c > 10 implies UX failure; M_d > 0.5 triggers alert layer.

layer2.mapping: GSI encodes U_x into confidence-weighted data summaries; GSE uses it to trigger dynamic UI state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: User engagement time vs. data summary completeness.
